name: Phosphates
aliases: E338, E339, E340, E341, E342, E343, E450, E451, E452, phosphoric acid, phosphates, sodium phosphates, potassium phosphates, calcium phosphates, ammonium phosphates, magnesium phosphates, diphosphates, pyrophosphates, triphosphates, polyphosphates
what_is: A broad family of phosphoric acid and phosphate additives used for functions that can include acidity control, sequestration, stabilisation, raising, moisture management and texture.
why_botia: BOTIA groups these declarations because related phosphate additives span E338–E343 and E450–E452 and can appear under several specific names. Regulatory safety assessments consider exposure from the diet as a whole; a single declared phosphate does not by itself establish excessive exposure.
can_1: Detect the listed E-numbers and common phosphate, diphosphate, triphosphate and polyphosphate declarations.
can_2: Show the texture/E-number context and distinguish the ingredient declaration from an exposure assessment.
cannot_1: Calculate total phosphorus or phosphate intake from the ingredient list.
cannot_2: Assume that every food containing an authorised phosphate presents the same exposure or risk.
